To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have found the analytic result for the virtual QCD corrections for the W boson production process at the LHC in the limit where the mass of the boson is small compared to the energy of the process.

we have found a way to calculate the two-loop corrections to the W pair production in the limit where the W boson mass can be neglected, which is the most important contribution to the total cross section.

(1) we have derived the two-loop virtual QCD corrections for the quark-annihilation W boson pair-production channel, (2) we have implemented these corrections into a Monte Carlo event generator and (3) the numerical implementation is publicly available.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the production of gauge boson pairs in high energy proton-proton collisions at the LHC and the derivation of the corresponding QCD corrections to next-to-leading order.
the calculation of the QCD corrections to high precision gauge boson production processes at the LHC.
the calculation of the two-loop virtual QCD corrections for the production of gauge boson pairs at the LHC in the high energy regime.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PSLQ method should only be used with caution, and that the results should be interpreted as a strong evidence of the sought relation, but short of rigorous proof of the conjectured identity.

, for the case of the W-pair production at the LHC, the two-loop virtual QCD corrections can be obtained by a numerical integration of the two-loop integrals, which are expressed in terms of the master integrals, and which have been calculated analytically in the limit of large kinematical invariances.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have derived all the two loop virtual corrections for the W boson production at the LHC in the limit of large energies and masses.
we have calculated the two loop QCD corrections to W-pair production in the quarks annihilation channel in the high energy limit.
the two loop virtual corrections are large, but they are not enough to cancel the large logarithmic contributions from the real emission corrections.

this method can be successfully used to compute two loop corrections to high energy scattering processes.
